# 1 Enoch Chapter 77 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all verses in 1 Enoch Chapter 77 where the three translators (EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA) significantly diverged in their renderings, along with SOPHIA's resolution and reasoning.

---

## 77:1 — The south and the divine descent

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-Most-High will-descend there, yea, there in-quite-a-special-sense will-He-who-is-blessed-for-ever-descend" | Literal; preserves the emphatic repetition |
| LOGOS | "the Most High will descend there — yea, there in quite a special sense will He who is blessed forever descend" | Preserves the emphatic construction |
| PNEUMA | "that is where the Blessed One will make his great descent" | Condenses the emphatic repetition; loses the emphasis |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS rendering. The emphatic repetition ('yea, there in quite a special sense') is a feature of the Ge'ez text's rhetorical style and should be preserved. PNEUMA's condensation loses the force of the double emphasis.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/EMET.

---

## 77:2 — 'diminished' for the west

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-diminished" | Literal; west is where luminaries diminish/wane |
| LOGOS | "the diminished" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the diminished" | All three agree on this unusual term |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three converge. 'The diminished' is an unusual term worth preserving — it encodes the cosmological explanation (luminaries wane there) directly into the name.

**Status:** Converged.

---

## 77:3 — 'garden of righteousness'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-garden-of-righteousness" | Literal Ge'ez construct |
| LOGOS | "the garden of righteousness" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "the garden of righteousness" | All three agree |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three converge. The 'garden of righteousness' echoes the Paradise/Eden tradition but with an eschatological character. It appears again in ch. 32 of 1 Enoch.

**Status:** Converged.

---
